intro.text: An outlaw in the Roughs whom Wax hunted for murder.

items.text: In Wax's fifth year in the Roughs, he tracked Joe for killing someone's son. Joe had found out Wax was Metalborn and set an ambush at Weathering's saloon, but in a standoff in its basement he was shot with a crossbow by Lessie, who he thought was on his side because he had paid her off.
